Condition : 1 - Marilyn Smith  020 8583 4994

References:	P/2008/1327P/2008/1326	00133/69-75/L300133/69-75/P9
Address:	69-75 Boston Manor Road, Brentford
Ward:	Brentford
Proposal:	Erection of a single storey detached building for use as storage to the existing premises 
Drawing numbers:	Drawing numbers BP/1701/BMR/04,  BP/1701/BMR/05 and BP/1701/BMR/06 received 18.4.08
Application received:	18.04.08

1.0	SUMMARY
1.1	The report contains an assessment of the proposed development in terms of Council policy and Guidelines.
1.2	The report concludes that the proposed erection of the garden room at the rear of the subject site does not accord with the London Borough of Hounslow's Residential Extension Guidelines and would be detrimental to the setting of the Listed Building. Refusal of the planning and listed building applications is recommended. 
2.0	SITE DESCRIPTION
2.1	The application site is located on the eastern side of Boston Manor Road Brentford. No 69-75 is a large detached building at the souther end of the road, used as offices. The building is listed
2.2	The building has a semi-basement, and the land around the building to the rear is at a lower level to allow light to the lower windows. 
2.3	There is a large car park area to the rear of the site.
3.0	HISTORY
3.1	00133/69-75/P7 Erection 3 storey office building approved subject to s106 25 July 2001.
3.2	00133/69-75/P8 Renewal of permission for erection 3 storey office building approved subject to s106 11 February 2008
4.0	DETAILS
4.1	The proposal is for erection of a single storey building for use as storage for the offices. It would be rectangular, measuring 6m x 12, with a pitched roof. It would be located south of the office building, on the boundary with the car park of the adjacent office building, Maycrete House. Materials will match the existing office building.
5.0	     CONSULTATIONS
